caption: The video depicts a dance studio with pale wood flooring, a mirror wall on the left, draped teal curtains, a ballet barre, plants, a standing fan, two lighting stands, and a wall logo. A barefoot woman in an olive tank top and black pants crouches right of center, bent forward with her left arm extended down, fingertips near the floor, and her right arm tucked behind her back. She sustains this posture throughout the clip, making only small adjustments as her torso and reaching hand shift slightly relative to the ground. The camera gradually reframes the view, widening the visible floor and repositioning the curtains, fan, stands, and logo. Her mirrored reflection tracks the same pose, moving within the glass only as the viewpoint changes. Soft shadows pool beneath her hand and feet.
